==Dialogue==
Before a [[Faded Memory]]:
:''"This is not my beautiful house. This is not my beautiful wife. Well, how did I get here?"''

After a Faded Memory:
:''"My memories have returned, and along with them my name and purpose. My name is Jutu. I served my noble and foolish king, [[King Reza|Reza]]. My people were [[the Cataclysm|damned]] to an underwater grave because a few foolish ones worshiped the forbidden god, [[Abaddon]]. Now, we all pay the price."''

==Trivia==
*His first dialogue is a reference to the song [[w:Once in a Lifetime (Talking Heads song)|"Once in a Lifetime"]] by the [[w:Talking Heads|Talking Heads]].
